castleton_garland.text: Twenty-ninth of May, the whole village turns out. The garland weighs more than a toddler and smells like a florist's bin. Lovely, though.
Stood by the lamp post since six this morning. Not for Garland Day. I've just got a very strong opinion on the pub opening times.

castleton_walker.text: Four caves in one village and I've done three. Peak Cavern, Speedwell, Treak Cliff. The Blue John one's still on the list.
They tell you to bring a lantern. I brought a head torch. It's the principle of the thing that dies first.
